clauses.text: The project budget is 120,000 EUR, with current spend at 110,000 EUR.
The breakdown of cost includes Engineering of 60,000 EUR and Procurement of 60,000 EUR, which sums to the contract total.
The budget contingency is set at 12,000 EUR, which is adequate for this project scope.
Project schedule status: delayed. Revised end date: 2025-11-30.
The milestone schedule dates are defined for the project duration.
Contract review schedule is to be determined pending project completion.
